faces.name: Invasion of Lorwyn
faces.text:
(As a Siege enters, choose an opponent to protect it. You and others can attack it. When it's defeated, exile it, then cast it transformed.)
When this Siege enters, destroy target non-Elf creature an opponent controls with power X or less, where X is the number of lands you control.

faces.name: Winnowing Forces
faces.text: Winnowing Forces's power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
